title: God Calls Abram
summary: Faith means following God even when we do not know every next step. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.

read_it.prompt: Read Genesis 12:1-9 and look for how this passage teaches: Faith means following God even when we do not know every next step.

tell_it: God told Abram to leave his country and promised to bless him. Abram trusted God and went.
understand_it: Faith means following God even when we do not know every next step. This lesson keeps the main point simple: God is faithful, His Word is true, and His people can respond with faith and obedience.
age_5_7_explanation: God Calls Abram reminds us that God is good and we can trust Him. Faith matters.
age_8_11_explanation: God Calls Abram shows that following God is not only knowing the story. It means learning this truth: Faith means following God even when we do not know every next step.
teen_explanation: God Calls Abram gives older students room to think about faith under pressure. The passage teaches that faith means following God even when we do not know every next step. It also asks how belief becomes action.
key_truths: Faith means following God even when we do not know every next step.
Faith means trusting God enough to respond.
God is faithful and His people can trust Him.
life_application: A kid can practice this when faith is needed: at school, with siblings, during disappointment, or when choosing between an easy wrong thing and a harder right thing.

quiz_questions.question: What did Abram do when God called him?
choices: He went as God told him
quiz_questions.answer: He went as God told him
quiz_questions.explanation: The passage points us back to this answer: He went as God told him. It helps kids remember the main event and the truth it teaches.

quiz_questions.question: This lesson teaches that faith means following God even when we do not know every next step.
quiz_questions.explanation: That is the plain lesson focus for this passage, stated in kid-friendly language.

memory_verse.prompt: Remember Genesis 12:4 as a short anchor for this lesson.

discussion_questions: What happened in God Calls Abram?
What does this passage teach us about God or following Him?
Where could this lesson help you at home, school, church, or with friends?

activity.title: Trust Map
activity.instructions: Draw or act out the lesson scene, then name the one clear truth: Faith means following God even when we do not know every next step.

prayer_prompt: Lord, help me learn from God Calls Abram. Teach me to trust You, listen to Your Word, and live this truth this week.
